title: kit.sim-profile.v1
description: A jurisdiction profile for @saasreport/sim: which national options of the standard it exercises, as overrides of table rows. An override outside the row's min and max (the standard's bounds), or of a row with no bounds, is refused; adding a profile needs no code change.

extends.description: Reserved: the profile this one refines; the baseline extends nothing.

ref.description: Where the national option is granted (a paragraph of the standard).

reason.description: Why this profile exercises it (the supervisor's rule or decision).
